theorem Paper.insertion_optimum: conclusion '(optSys n x w).rule x = [x] /\ (optSys n x w).rule (!x) = List.replicate (optP n x w) x ++ (!x) :: List.replicate (optQ n x w) x /\ optP n x w + optQ n x w = insP n x w /\ (optSys n x w).derive n = w /\ (optSys n x w).start.length + n * w.count (!x) * insP n x w = w.length /\ forall (S : DOL Bool) (p q : nat), S.rule x = [x] -> S.rule (!x) = List.replicate p x ++ (!x) :: List.replicate q x -> S.derive n = w -> p + q <= insP n x w /\ (optSys n x w).start.length <= S.start.length' proved equivalent to formal '(optSys n x w).rule x = [x] /\ ((optSys n x w).rule !x) = List.replicate (optP n x w) x ++ (!x) :: List.replicate (optQ n x w) x /\ optP n x w + optQ n x w = insP n x w /\ (optSys n x w).derive n = w /\ (optSys n x w).start.length + n * List.count (!x) w * insP n x w = w.length /\ forall (S : DOL Bool) (p q : nat), S.rule x = [x] -> (S.rule !x) = List.replicate p x ++ (!x) :: List.replicate q x -> S.derive n = w -> p + q <= insP n x w /\ (optSys n x w).start.length <= S.start.length'

theorem Paper.insertion_optimum_dsize: conclusion 'dsize [x, !x] (optSys n x w) + (n * w.count (!x) - 1) * insP n x w = w.length + 2 /\ forall (S : DOL Bool) (p q : nat), S.rule x = [x] -> S.rule (!x) = List.replicate p x ++ (!x) :: List.replicate q x -> S.derive n = w -> dsize [x, !x] (optSys n x w) <= dsize [x, !x] S' proved equivalent to formal 'dsize [x, !x] (optSys n x w) + (n * List.count (!x) w - 1) * insP n x w = w.length + 2 /\ forall (S : DOL Bool) (p q : nat), S.rule x = [x] -> (S.rule !x) = List.replicate p x ++ (!x) :: List.replicate q x -> S.derive n = w -> dsize [x, !x] (optSys n x w) <= dsize [x, !x] S'
